# marked

`marked.esm.js` and `LICENSE` are the unmodified dist files from marked 18.1.0, MIT,
© 2018+ MarkedJS, © 2011-2018 Christopher Jeffrey.

- Release: `https://github.com/markedjs/marked/releases/tag/v18.1.0`
- Dist file: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.1.0/lib/marked.esm.js`
- No build step; imported as an ES module.

Used by the console's F1 command reference to render the owner's manual as GitHub-flavored Markdown.
